# System Security Plan: Eastport Benefits Portal

*Generated by Castellan on 2026-06-10. This is an SSP skeleton: control
implementation narratives must be completed by the system owner.*

## 1. System Identification

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| System name | Eastport Benefits Portal |
| System identifier | EBP-001 |
| System owner | City of Eastport — IT Services |
| Overall categorization | moderate |
| Selected baseline | SP 800-53B moderate (287 controls) |

## 2. System Description

Public-facing web application where residents apply for municipal benefit programs. A single Ubuntu host runs the web tier and database; staff review applications through an authenticated admin interface.

### Components

- Ubuntu 22.04 web server (nginx + gunicorn)
- PostgreSQL 15 database
- OpenSSH for administrative access

## 3. FIPS-199 Security Categorization

| Information Type | Confidentiality | Integrity | Availability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Applicant PII (names, addresses, income records) | moderate | moderate | low |
| Public program information pages | low | moderate | low |
| Staff authentication credentials | moderate | moderate | low |

| Security Objective | Impact Level |
| --- | --- |
| Confidentiality | moderate |
| Integrity | moderate |
| Availability | low |

**Rationale:** per FIPS-199, the overall categorization is the high-water mark
across the three security objectives (each objective itself the high-water mark
across the system's information types):
confidentiality = moderate, integrity = moderate,
availability = low → **moderate**. Per FIPS-200,
this selects the SP 800-53B **moderate** baseline.
